definitions: A large toothed whale (Physeter macrocephalus) with a massive, square-shaped head, known for its production of spermaceti.
A marine mammal famous for its deep diving capabilities and its role in historical whaling.
examples: The sperm whale is the largest toothed predator.
Sperm whales communicate using a series of clicks.
A sperm whale can hold its breath for a long time.
